about_the_game:
This DLC gives access to the game's Digital Artbook (which can be found within the installation folder) and two exclusive weapons that can be purchased from in-game vendors.

DIGITAL ARTBOOK 

Spanning 85 pages of high-grade visual overload, The Ascent artbook pulls back the curtain on the neon-lit, blood-stained, ruthless world of Veles. Packed with original concept art and high-resolution custom renders of the corpo-run metropolis, characters, branding and more, every page is a reminder - someone built this world before you blew it to hell. 

 

Pure distilled Cyberpunk chaos awaits you. 

 

THE PERSUADER 

The Persuader is an almost mythical weapon. Not because of its disco inspired pray and spray – but because nobody knows where they come from. They’re as rare as they’re dangerous. Very. The lucky few indents with one in possession are usually very keen to show them off, regardless of it's a good time or not. 

 

BITSPLIT SHOTGUN 

If you're pure organic, you've got nothing to fear from this shotgun. Fortunately for you, very few people are. A few ones and zeros will never quite pack the same punch against flesh as a good chunk of metal, but a completely digitalized weapon is both environmentally friendly and the perfect tool to take out robots.
